records.scope: Season 3, Chapters 17–24: selected-profile episode appearances, new supporting profiles and five scoped performance credits; memories and manual droid bodies distinguished.
limitations: Seasons 1–3, Chapters 1–24, have selected-profile episode reviews. Season 3 uses 43 considered profiles and named official text evidence, not a complete scene-by-scene census. Omitted connections remain unestablished, not absent. Full cast, world and vehicle coverage remains open.

Grogu’s Order 66 rescue, Kelleran, Coruscant and escape vehicles are explicitly scoped as memory/flashback. IG-12 is a manual droid body, distinct from IG-11. Named dialogue, retrospective comparisons, destinations and general related links do not establish physical scenes.

Specific open season-three scenes include Peli’s visit, Kane’s remote communications, the later Koska/Axe scenes, Carson’s finale scene, the covert world and named individual starfighter/cruiser scenes. Earlier season-one/two unresolved scenes remain open; this batch does not turn their omissions into absence.
Episode inventories and scoped writing roles remain valid. New selected cast credits are episode-specific; this is not a complete end-credit or music-department review.

Current release-date research is restricted to the original US launch of each work and, when necessary to distinguish a documented version, its first US release. Existing sourced events are retained. Worldwide/Finland dates, later platform availability, routine rereleases and exhaustive master comparisons are deferred rather than factually resolved.
Released television Chapters 1–24 only. Related features, LEGO retellings and The Book of Boba Fett remain separate works. No new release dates, editions, media assets or opening transcript imported.
